description: Enable or disable a single player control on every CONVERTED video in a folder, via player profiles, PRESERVING all other controls. The big play button (dashboard 'Botão de Play Grande') is the 'play-large' control — disable it with control='play-large', enabled=false. Each video's profile controls are read-modify-written; when a profile has no explicit control list it inherits the global player controls, so the action materializes that global list minus/plus the control. Videos without a profile get one created and assigned. dry_run=true (default) validates + previews per-video changes.

control.description: Player control to toggle. 'play-large' = the big center play button.

dry_run.description: true = validate + preview only; false = apply

enabled.description: true = show the control, false = hide/disable it

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

name: panda_action_set_folder_player_control
title: Toggle a Player Control for Folder
